recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞核卵圓、染色質細緻，淡藍色細顆粒狀細胞質中含三顆被吞噬、周圍有空泡的紅血球，代表噬紅血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and a single oval eccentric nucleus
Three intact phagocytosed red cells within clear cytoplasmic vacuoles (phagosomes)
Nuclear chromatin fine to moderately condensed without visible nucleoli
Cell membrane with fine cytoplasmic fraying at edges
Background of thick, clumped red cell areas typical of aspirate smear; no other nucleated cells in field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and an oval nucleus with fine chromatin. The cytoplasm contains three intact phagocytosed erythrocytes, each within a clear vacuole. The surrounding background consists of red cells without other nucleated elements in this field. Findings represent hemophagocytosis (erythrophagocytosis); in the appropriate clinical context this supports but is not by itself diagnostic of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis involves intact hematopoietic cells passing through a large lobulated megakaryocyte, whereas this is a mononuclear macrophage containing digested red cells in phagosomes.
Superimposed red cells lie on top of the cytoplasm without surrounding clear phagocytic vacuoles and appear in different focal planes.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion or infection
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; clinical HLH criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, sCD25, NK function) rather than a single hemophagocyte separate HLH from nonspecific reactive phagocytosis.

ddx.dx: Erythrophagocytosis by leukemic blasts (e.g., AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: In t(8;16) AML the phagocytic cells are monocytic blasts with immature chromatin and nucleoli, unlike this mature macrophage.
